docs: Features content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of two to eight features, each with an optional icon picture, a title and a line. One object is valid in every features layout (columns under the heading, the heading beside them, markers at the side, a checklist).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the features, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the icon picture of the feature; none: the placeholder

description.docs: one line about the feature; empty: none
